details.description: Stable Image Ultra is Stability AI's flagship image generation model, available on Amazon Bedrock as stability.stable-image-ultra-v1:1. Stability AI describes it as its most advanced text-to-image service, built for the highest image quality and prompt understanding, and states it excels at typography, complex compositions, dynamic lighting, and vibrant color. It supports both text-to-image generation from a prompt and image-to-image generation using an existing image as a starting point.
advantages: Stability AI describes it as its most advanced text-to-image service, built for 'the highest quality images with unprecedented prompt understanding' (Stability AI API reference).
Stability AI states the model 'excels in typography, complex compositions, dynamic lighting, vibrant hues, and overall cohesion and structure of an art piece' (Stability AI API reference).

Supports both text-to-image generation and image-to-image generation from a starting image, with an adjustable strength parameter for how closely the output follows the source image (AWS Bedrock documentation).
disadvantages: Output images are limited to 640-1,536 pixels on each side (AWS Bedrock documentation).
use_cases: Text-to-image generation from a descriptive prompt
Image-to-image generation using an existing image as a starting point
Photorealistic, large-scale visuals for brand and marketing campaigns

sources.title: API Reference - Stability AI Developer Platform

notes: The catalog's max_input_tokens (77) does not match either source: Stability AI's own API reference and AWS Bedrock's request docs both give the prompt limit as 0-10,000 characters, not a 77-token count; kept the catalog's value as instructed. No accuracy-style (0-100, higher-is-better) benchmark scores were found on Stability AI's or AWS's pages, so evaluations is empty. Stable Image Ultra is listed as a currently supported model on Bedrock's Stability AI models page (uris only cover the Bedrock host, so no separate maker-side deprecation status page was checked).
